audit_items.proof_trace: The batch verification delegates to external c-kzg-4844 library without passing domain separator or evaluations. Specification defines RANDOM_CHALLENGE_KZG_CELL_BATCH_DOMAIN constant but it's unused in codebase, creating trust boundary risk that Fiat-Shamir challenge may not include all required data.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker submits malicious data column sidecars via P2P with crafted proofs. If external library's challenge construction omits evaluations or domain separation, attacker could reuse valid proofs with different cell data, bypassing verification through incomplete challenge binding.
